description: Abstract class defining a purge strategy for the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin, including methods for managing purge operations, service access, and data retrieval based on employee number.

classes.name: PurgeStrategy
classes.description: Abstract class providing a template for purge strategies within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin, managing entity class names, parameters, field mappings, and purge services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the purge strategy with entity class name and info array data.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Abstract method to perform purge operation based on employee number.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the PurgeService instance.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Constructs a match criteria array based on employee number and entity field map.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Retrieves entity records from the database using purge DAO.

methods.name: getEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Returns the entity field mapping array.
